title: Champion monsters
changes: About one monster in twenty now comes as a named champion, glowing in its family's colour, with two and a half times the health and a rune always in its loot.

Each family has its own champion powers: blobs that split or leave puddles, skeletons that rise again or set up a ballista, beast-folk that tear into their other skin, Redfang ringleaders who whistle up cutthroats.

In the Sunscar, Veiled adepts burn with the second sun, Kharsun's dead burst out of the sand, scorpions leave venom trails, Dustriders step out of a veil behind you and branded camel-folk stamp you with the Circle's sun.
Small icons over a champion show its powers; bosses, elites and the Night Raiders are never champions.
